overview.Module Title: Sustainability and Ethics in Cultural and Creative Industries

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: Aims: This module aims to offer a critical study of key sectors and operating practices in the creative, cultural and new media industries. Objectives: To develop the issues of new media / contemporary computing production within a global context and the dynamic changes occurring within.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate a critical awareness of the increasing challenges faced in producing critical, creative work within a contemporary global context B Analyse critically the existing and developing structures and behaviors of organizations in the creative industries C Demonstrate a comprehensive knowledge of ethics; historical and contemporary D Develop original practical work informed by relevant critical theory and practice
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered through a combination of lectures, tutorials and seminars.
